claims.statement: manifold-train composes environment + recipe + network configs, defers the VAE-encode latent warm into DataModule.setup() so the per-rank i % world == rank sharding activates (ADR-0017), then trains LatentFlowModule with logit-normal timesteps and JiT's (1-t)^-2 weighted clean-latent prediction loss. The noise-to-data production flow disables validation when no held-out source is wired and refuses to reuse training data as validation.

The supervised ControlNet CLI runs two validators: val/x0_mae from the non-registry LatentX0MAE extra callback is the active checkpoint monitor (mode=min, save_top_k=3), and the in-training PairedFidelityCallback (val/psnr / val/ssim, ADR-0037) is the observe-only companion — it never drives checkpoint selection, never enters the loss, and never touches the optimizer or EMA. The paired-fidelity spec is in the supervised CLI's default callback-name set alongside train_loss and checkpoint.

PairedFidelitySpec declares four knobs (subset_size, every_n_epochs, num_inference_steps, seed) and logged_metrics=frozenset({"val/psnr","val/ssim"}). The rollout step count is recipe-primary: the spec's num_inference_steps defaults to None and PairedFidelitySpec.build reads it from CallbackContext.inference_recipe["num_inference_steps"], which the supervised CLI fills from controlnet.num_inference_steps (default 15 ⇒ 29 UNet evals); an explicit per-callback value overrides the recipe. The fixed paired subset is resolved lazily through getattr(source, "val_latent_ds", source) so the cold-path setup() replacement is honored.

Under DDP every rank evaluates the same fixed paired subset redundantly (DDP-synchronized weights + identical seeded noise + identical fixed input ⇒ identical per-rank result), so the cross-rank reduction is just Lightning's torchmetrics sync on the two module-attached MeanMetric instances. There is no FID-style sharding and no error-rendezvous machinery on this path; tests/test_paired_fidelity_ddp.py's 2-rank gate locks both the no-hang and the per-rank value-equality claims.

The offline BeforeAfterEval PSNR/SSIM and the in-training PairedFidelityCallback share the same PairedFidelityMetrics, the same min_max_to_unit normalization (data_range=1.0), and the same ControlNet rollout primitive by construction, so the in-training val/psnr/val/ssim curve and the offline metrics.json are directly comparable. A change to the metric, normalization, or rollout step count on either side without the other is a comparison bug that crosses pipeline_utils, controlnet_latent_flow, paired.py, paired_callback.py, and before_after.py.

There is one GRPO recipe (configs/train/config_grpo.yaml) and one console entry (manifold-train-grpo); the policy is inferred from the native artifact under --native-dir — a raw JiT export trains the UNet, a supervised ControlNet export trains the ControlNet on its frozen base. There is no --grpo-mode flag. grpo_train.lr is the UNet-policy default; the optional controlnet.lr applies only to the ControlNet path and falls back to grpo_train.lr. The shared mode-agnostic RewardModel scores the terminal latent z_K unconditionally for both paths.

For the ControlNet policy path, unconditional FID is suppressed two ways: at default-derivation (the constant frozen-base metric is skipped) and post-merge via TrainingSpine.run forbidden_callbacks={"fid": ...} / forbidden_monitors={"val/fid": ...} (ADR-0032), so a YAML or --callbacks override cannot re-enable FID or a val/fid checkpoint monitor. Checkpoint selection on the ControlNet path uses val/mean_reward.

The GRPO singular-branch rollout walks two slices per branch through FlowMatchGRPOScheduler.rollout_range (ADR-0005 single-copy): the anchor slice 0→max_k (deterministic Heun, shared by every sibling) and the suffix slice k+1→n (per-sibling stochastic SDE branch that produces the GRPO group). The method lives on the scheduler, not as a free function in grpo.py; both the partial and GRPO schedulers inherit FlowMatchHeunDiscreteScheduler.heun_rollout verbatim. Source-level guards in tests/test_grpo.py and tests/test_scheduler.py lock the absence of _heun_one_step / _heun_rollout free functions and the inherited-primitive identity.

Export is the sole checkpoint-to-native bridge: training .ckpt → manifold-export → native per-component dir consumed by LatentFlowPipeline.from_pretrained (--pipeline jit) or ControlNetLatentFlowPipeline.from_pretrained (--pipeline controlnet, requires --base-native-dir to restore the frozen base). The ControlNet .ckpt registers only the trainable ControlNet (FrozenArmMixin ADR-0031 A1: state_dict() strips the frozen base, load_state_dict strict-loads trainable keys with the frozen arms as an allow-list), so export bakes only controlnet.* keys and passes the base through verbatim. --pipeline paired is a stale reference: manifold.pipelines.paired_latent_flow.PairedLatentFlowPipeline was deleted in ADR-0034 and is not exercised.

manifold-eval is the only shipped eval console entry. It infers the policy from the before native artifact's model_index.json pipeline_class (no --policy flag), exports the after .ckpt through the standard export_to_native bridge to <output>/after_native, reloads both fresh pipelines, and runs the same-seed BeforeAfterEval driver: JiT emits a before|after grid with provenance only, ControlNet additionally scores each generated target against its real target with PairedFidelityMetrics. A separate library-only ComparisonPageBuilder turns the local artifacts plus optional JiT metrics.csv into a self-contained HTML report with base64-embedded PNGs.

Two native inference pipelines are exercised: LatentFlowPipeline (JiT noise-to-data, UNet + scheduler + frozen VAE) and ControlNetLatentFlowPipeline (paired translator, frozen JiT base UNet + trainable ControlNet + scheduler + frozen VAE). Both share the per-component save_pretrained / from_pretrained contract and delegate to the same rollout primitive as the training modules (controlnet_rollout for the paired path, sample_latent_flow / heun_rollout for the JiT path), so training and inference cannot drift (ADR-0005). PairedLatentFlowPipeline is gone (ADR-0034); --pipeline paired in manifold-export is a stale reference.
